C6 Interconnect Requirements
C6.4 Transaction responses from the interconnect


C6.4    Transaction responses from the interconnect

                 The interconnect must provide a response for all transactions from an initiating master.

                    Table C6-2 shows the permitted response from the interconnect for a transaction issued on the AR channel.

                                 Table C6-2 Permitted interconnect response for a transaction on the AR channel

                               Transaction from initiating master   Permitted response from the interconnect

                                                                   IsShared, RRESP[3]   PassDirty, RRESP[2]

                              ReadNoSnoop                       0                     0

                               ReadOnce                           0                     0

                                                                   1                     0

                                 ReadClean                          0                     0

ReadUnique                         0                     0

                                                                   0                     1

                                 CleanUnique                         0                     0

                              MakeUnique                         0                     0

                                  CleanShared                         0                     0

                                                                   1                     0

                                     CleanInvalid                         0                     0

                                  MakeInvalid                         0                     0


                 The interconnect must determine the IsShared response for the following transactions from the initiating master:
                          •    ReadOnce
                          •     ReadClean
                          •     ReadNotSharedDirty
                          •     ReadShared
                          •     CleanShared.

•     ReadClean
                          •     ReadNotSharedDirty
                          •     ReadShared
                          •     CleanShared.

                                    After snooping all the required cached masters, the PassDirty response to the initiating master for these transactions

                                           •       If PassDirty was asserted for any snoop response received by the interconnect, and the interconnect has not

                                  Note
                              Only transactions initiated on the AR channel have additional response bits returned with the transaction response
                                       to the initiating master on the R channel.  只有AR通道对应的响应通道R拥有这些响应信号


                                  Write transactions do not have additional response bits, and the response from the transaction that passes through
                                     the interconnect can be returned directly to the initiating master. The write transactions are:
                                           •     WriteNoSnoop
                                           •     WriteUnique
                                           •     WriteLineUnique
                                           •     WriteBack
                                           •     WriteClean.

•     WriteLineUnique
                                           •     WriteBack
                                           •     WriteClean.

                         An Evict transaction does not propagate downstream and the interconnect is required to generate an OKAY,
